paragraphs.text: Four Bloomburrow Commander decks were released together with Bloomburrow on August 2, 2024.

The four Bloomburrow Commander decks each contain 10 new cards with the BLC set code. Main Commanders appear as Borderless cards (#0001-0004), while the alternate commanders (#0005-0008) and the rest of the new cards (#0009-0040) appear as normal cards. These cards are permitted in the Commander , Legacy , and Vintage formats. The other cards in these decks (with printed set code BLC and collector numbers #0105-0355) that have been previously printed are legal for play in any format where a card with the same name is permitted.
In Collector Boosters , Main Commanders can appear as anime raised foil versions (#0101-0104), and the rest of the new cards as extended art versions (#0041-0072).

There are several additional cards with the BLC code, that aren't to be found in the Commander decks. These are the Imagine: Courageous Critters (collector numbers #0073-0100; raised foil #0093-0096), and the Bloomburrow Buy-a-Box card Flubs, the Fool (#0356).
1 foil borderless Planeswalker with new Imagine: Courageous Critters art

Each deck introduces 15 never-before-seen Commander cards to Magic: The Gathering . Several reprints in the Commander decks have updated art, some (but not all) of which is suited to the Bloomburrow theme:
Across the four Bloomburrow Commander decks, there are four cycles.

Zinnia, Valley's Voice received a functional errata with the release of Lorwyn Eclipsed on January 23, 2026. The change specifically impacts the offspring ability; the card’s oracle text has gone from “creature spells you cast have offspring ” to “creature spells you cast gain offspring as you cast them.” This ensures creature spells you cast while controlling Zinnia have offspring at all times; as printed, this is not the case. The offspring ability would fizzle if Zinnia died, even if you paid the cost.
